window.title: AXStaticText = '<user> — -zsh — WxH' in AXWindow
window.textArea: AXTextArea of AXScrollArea of AXSplitGroup of AXWindow — full terminal buffer
window.splitPane: Two AXScrollArea inside AXSplitGroup when split active
window.toolbar: AXButton × 3 at top of window (Split, Inspector, Profile avatar)
window.inspectorButton: AXButton[2] of AXWindow — opens Shell Inspector

input.promptLine: Last line of AXTextArea value — ends with '% ' or '$ '
input.sendCommand: set value of AXTextArea + key code 36 (Return)
input.pasteEscaped: Edit > Paste Escaped Text (Ctrl+Cmd+V) — escapes special chars before pasting

settings.profiles: Built-in: Basic, Grass, Homebrew, Man Page, Novel, Ocean, Pro, Red Sands, Silver Aerogel, Solid Colors

steps: tell application "Terminal" to activate
tell application "System Events"
tell process "Terminal"
set value of text area 1 of scroll area 1 of splitter group 1 of window 1 to "your command"
key code 36  -- Return
end tell
end tell
run_command.applescript: tell application "Terminal" to do script "echo hello" in window 1
run_command.note: do script is BLOCKED by ScreenHand. Use System Events text area approach instead.

steps: tell application "System Events"
tell process "Terminal"
return value of text area 1 of scroll area 1 of splitter group 1 of window 1
end tell
end tell
read_output.note: Returns entire visible buffer as string. Parse last line for prompt, preceding lines for output.

steps: Cmd+N — new window with default profile
Ctrl+Cmd+N — new window with same command as current
Cmd+T — new tab with default profile
Ctrl+Cmd+T — new tab with same command
Cmd+D — split current window into two panes (side by side)
Shift+Cmd+D — close split pane
Click in either pane to focus
Shift+Cmd+K — New Remote Connection dialog
Select protocol: SSH / SFTP / FTP / Telnet
Enter server address + user
Click Connect — opens new tab with SSH session
ssh_remote.applescript_alternative: tell application "Terminal" to do script "ssh user@host"

steps: Select a command name in terminal output
Ctrl+Cmd+? — Open man Page for Selection
OR: Ctrl+Option+Cmd+/ — Search man Page Index
Cmd++ — bigger
Cmd+- — smaller
Cmd+0 — reset to default
Cmd+F (or View > Enter Full Screen)
Terminal menu > Secure Keyboard Entry (toggle)
secure_keyboard_entry.note: Prevents other apps from reading keystrokes — use when typing passwords

steps: Shell > Export Text As… (Cmd+S) — saves entire buffer as .txt
Shell > Export Selected Text As… (Shift+Cmd+S) — saves selection only
Shell > Use Settings as Default — applies current window profile as default
Shell > Export Settings… — exports .terminal profile file
Open .terminal file (Cmd+O) — opens new window with that profile
Window > Save Windows as Group… — saves all current windows/tabs as named group
Window > Open Window Group — restore saved group
Useful for restoring complex multi-tab dev setups
Read terminal output:
tell process "Terminal" → value of text area 1 of scroll area 1 of splitter group 1
Type into terminal:
set value of text area 1 to "command" → key code 36
NOTE: 'do script' is blocked by ScreenHand security policy

do_script_blocked.description: tell application "Terminal" to do script "..." is blocked by ScreenHand (shell execution restriction)
do_script_blocked.workaround: Use System Events: set value of text area 1 of scroll area 1 of splitter group 1 of window 1 to "command", then key code 36

window_not_found.description: Terminal window may not exist if app just launched
window_not_found.workaround: Open new window first with Cmd+N or wait 0.5s after activate

text_area_path.description: AX path varies — text area is nested: text area 1 of scroll area 1 of splitter group 1 of window 1
text_area_path.workaround: Always use splitter group 1 in path even when not split

websiteFeatures.name: Run Shell Commands
websiteFeatures.description: Execute any Unix/bash/zsh command. Full shell access with PATH, env vars, stdin/stdout/stderr.

websiteFeatures.name: Tabs (Cmd+T)
websiteFeatures.description: Multiple terminal sessions in one window. Each tab is independent shell. Name tabs. New Tab with Same Command repeats last command.

websiteFeatures.name: Multiple Windows (Cmd+N)
websiteFeatures.description: Open multiple Terminal windows. Save window groups for dev setups. Merge all windows into tabs.

websiteFeatures.name: Split Pane (Cmd+D)
websiteFeatures.description: Split window horizontally into two independent panes. Each pane runs its own shell. Close with Shift+Cmd+D.

websiteFeatures.name: Profiles
websiteFeatures.description: 10 built-in themes: Basic, Pro, Homebrew, Grass, Ocean, etc. Customize font, colors, cursor, window size. Per-window/tab profile. Export as .terminal files.

websiteFeatures.name: Font Size Control
websiteFeatures.description: Cmd+Plus (bigger), Cmd+Minus (smaller), Cmd+0 (reset). Per-session, non-destructive.

websiteFeatures.name: Find in Buffer (Cmd+F)
websiteFeatures.description: Search terminal scrollback for text. Find next/prev, use selection as search term. Works across entire buffer.

websiteFeatures.name: Marks & Bookmarks
websiteFeatures.description: Mark lines (Cmd+U) to create navigation anchors. Bookmarks (Option+Cmd+U) for named positions. Jump between marks (Cmd+Up/Down). Select between marks (Shift+Cmd+A).

websiteFeatures.name: Scrollback Buffer
websiteFeatures.description: Scroll through command history output. Page Up/Down (Cmd+Up/Down). Scroll to top (Cmd+Home), bottom (Cmd+End). Clear scrollback (Option+Cmd+K).

websiteFeatures.name: SSH / Remote Connection (Shift+Cmd+K)
websiteFeatures.description: Built-in New Remote Connection dialog for SSH, SFTP, FTP, Telnet. Opens new tab per connection.

websiteFeatures.name: man Page Lookup
websiteFeatures.description: Select any command > Ctrl+Cmd+? opens its man page in new window. Ctrl+Option+Cmd+/ searches man page index. Essential for command reference.

websiteFeatures.name: Secure Keyboard Entry
websiteFeatures.description: Terminal menu toggle. Blocks other apps from reading keystrokes. Use when entering passwords/API keys.

websiteFeatures.name: Paste Escaped Text (Ctrl+Cmd+V)
websiteFeatures.description: Pastes clipboard content with special characters escaped (spaces, quotes, etc.). Safe for pasting file paths or code snippets.

websiteFeatures.name: Export Terminal Transcript
websiteFeatures.description: Shell > Export Text As (Cmd+S) saves full buffer to .txt. Export Selected saves just selection. Good for saving command output.

websiteFeatures.name: Inspector & Custom Title
websiteFeatures.description: Cmd+I opens Shell Inspector (title, command, PID, profile). Shift+Cmd+I to set custom tab/window title.

websiteFeatures.name: Window Groups
websiteFeatures.description: Window > Save Windows as Group — saves all open windows/tabs as named group. Restore later. Perfect for dev environment snapshots.

websiteFeatures.name: Full Screen (Cmd+F)
websiteFeatures.description: Expands terminal to full screen. Immersive coding mode.

websiteFeatures.name: Alternate Screen
websiteFeatures.description: Toggle alternate screen buffer (used by vim, less, man). Shift+Cmd+↑/↓ to show/hide. Keeps main scrollback clean.

websiteFeatures.name: Mouse Reporting (Cmd+R)
websiteFeatures.description: Allow terminal apps (tmux, vim) to receive mouse events for click-to-position, scroll, etc.

websiteFeatures.name: AppleScript / ScreenHand Automation
websiteFeatures.description: Read terminal output via AX tree (text area 1 of scroll area 1 of splitter group 1). Type commands by setting text area value + Return. 'do script' blocked by ScreenHand policy.

valueAddFeatures.name: Summarize
valueAddFeatures.description: Read and summarize all Terminal content

valueAddFeatures.name: Change Monitor
valueAddFeatures.description: Monitor Terminal for changes and notify

additionalFeatures.name: Drag & Drop Files/Folders
additionalFeatures.description: Drag file/folder into Terminal to insert absolute path on command line. Hold Cmd to skip escaping.

additionalFeatures.name: Drag & Drop Colors
additionalFeatures.description: Drag a color swatch from the color panel onto a Terminal window to change its background color.

additionalFeatures.name: Drag & Drop Text Clippings
additionalFeatures.description: Drag .textClipping files directly into the prompt. Content is inserted as-is.

additionalFeatures.name: URL Detection
additionalFeatures.description: Terminal auto-detects URLs in output. Cmd+double-click opens URL in browser.

additionalFeatures.name: File Path Selection
additionalFeatures.description: Shift+Cmd+double-click selects an entire file path in terminal output.

additionalFeatures.name: Rectangular Block Selection
additionalFeatures.description: Option+drag selects a rectangular region of text across multiple lines.

additionalFeatures.name: Command Line Editing Shortcuts
additionalFeatures.description: Ctrl+A (start), Ctrl+E (end), Ctrl+U (delete line), Ctrl+K (delete to end), Ctrl+W (delete word), Ctrl+T (transpose).

additionalFeatures.name: Reverse History Search
additionalFeatures.description: Ctrl+R opens incremental search through shell command history. Type to filter, Enter to run, Escape to cancel.

additionalFeatures.name: Option as Meta Key
additionalFeatures.description: Cmd+Option+O toggle. Enables Emacs/readline Meta key combos (e.g. Meta+F to move forward one word).

additionalFeatures.name: Break (Cmd+.)
additionalFeatures.description: Cmd+Period sends interrupt signal — equivalent to Ctrl+C. Stops running command.

additionalFeatures.name: Soft + Hard Reset
additionalFeatures.description: Option+Cmd+R (soft reset): resets terminal state. Ctrl+Option+Cmd+R (hard reset): full reset including alternate screen.

additionalFeatures.name: Bell / Visual Alert Config
additionalFeatures.description: Settings > Profiles > Advanced: audible bell, visual bell flash, badge app icon, bounce Dock icon (once or until foreground).

additionalFeatures.name: Limit Scrollback Rows
additionalFeatures.description: Settings > Profiles > Window: limit scrollback to N rows (default 10,000) or available memory.

additionalFeatures.name: Encodings Settings
additionalFeatures.description: Settings > Encodings toolbar tab: enable/disable encodings per profile. UTF-8/16/32, ISO Latin, Japanese, ASCII, EBCDIC and more.

additionalFeatures.name: Keyboard Key Mappings
additionalFeatures.description: Settings > Profiles > Keyboard: map function keys to escape sequences. Per-profile. Option as Meta key toggle. Scroll alternate screen toggle.

additionalFeatures.name: Import / Export Profiles
additionalFeatures.description: Shell > Export Settings… saves profile as .terminal file. Open > .terminal file imports it. Share profiles across machines.

additionalFeatures.name: Character Viewer
additionalFeatures.description: Edit > Emoji & Symbols (Ctrl+Cmd+Space): opens system character picker to insert emoji, symbols, special chars.

additionalFeatures.name: launchd Task Scheduling
additionalFeatures.description: Create ~/Library/LaunchAgents/*.plist files to schedule shell scripts via launchd. Terminal runs the scripts on schedule.

additionalFeatures.name: Color Picker
additionalFeatures.description: Edit > Show Colors (Shift+Cmd+C): opens system color panel. Drag colors to Terminal window to change background. Also accessible via Profile text/bg color wells.

additionalFeatures.name: Window Title Customization
additionalFeatures.description: Settings > Profiles > Window > Title: show process name, TTY, dimensions, profile name, arguments, shell command, working directory, or custom escape sequence.
